Property management / GOLD COAST

A clear scope for body corporate repairs

Defect lists, approved work areas and useful completion records.

Ellis Services Group · Maintenance notes

We begin a body corporate maintenance job with the approved work area and the nominated representative. Queensland's guidance explains that maintenance responsibilities depend on the subdivision plan and boundaries. We use the information provided for the property to define the job, rather than assuming every balcony, door or surface has the same ownership arrangement.

A useful defect list identifies the location, symptom and access requirement for each item. We group related repairs, note where investigation is needed and distinguish the immediate work from wider improvements. This gives the manager a scope that can be reviewed and approved.

We coordinate access to shared spaces and any resident notices through the property representative. At completion, we provide photos and a list of the work carried out, together with remaining items that require a separate decision or attendance.
